prompt.zh-TW: 林姊想比較晴川花坊「今年上半年」和「去年上半年」哪一段做得比較好。該看哪一張報表？
prompt.en: Lin wants to compare how Clearwater Florist did in the first half of this year against the first half of last year. Which statement should she look at?

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。損益表就是一段期間的成績單，兩段期間各拿一張來比最直接。
feedback.en: Correct. The income statement is the report card for a period; comparing one for each half-year is the most direct way.

feedback.zh-TW: 資產負債表是某一天的快照，拿兩張來比只看得出餘額的差異，看不出哪一段「做得」比較好。
feedback.en: The balance sheet is a snapshot of one day; comparing two only shows differences in balances, not which period was run better.

feedback.zh-TW: 現金流量表能比現金的進出，但現金多未必是做得好，可能只是借了錢。
feedback.en: The statement of cash flows can compare cash movements, but more cash does not mean a better performance; it may simply have been borrowed.

explanation.zh-TW: 「哪一段期間做得比較好」是期間的問題，看{{option:o_4t8s}}。{{option:o_m08k}}只是時點快照；{{option:o_55ck}}的現金可能受借款與買設備影響，不等於經營成績。
explanation.en: ‘Which period was better’ is a question about a period, so look at {{option:o_4t8s}}. {{option:o_m08k}} is only a snapshot, and the cash on {{option:o_55ck}} can be swayed by loans and equipment purchases, so it is not a measure of performance.
